data.name: Enrico
data.gender_notes: Enrico is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Henricus', which means 'ruler of the home'. Enricos have been renowned leaders and influential figures throughout history. In Christianity, St. Henry is the patron saint of the Rothenburg ob der Tauber in Germany. The name Enrico carries the meaning “Rich, powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Enrico usually hope their child will grow to embody rich, powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and leadership, inspiring confidence and loyalty.
data.etymology: Enrico belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rich, powerful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enrico total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אנריקו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנריקו הוא שם שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אדון הבית' או 'משליט הבית'. השם מורכב מ'היים' שפירושו בית ו'ריך' שפירושו אדון או משליט. השם אנריקו הוא גרסה של השם היינריך, ששימש כמלכים וקיסרים גרמנים רבים. לאור זאת, השם אנריקו נושא עמו קונוטציות של כוח, מנהיגות ואדנות.

in_greek.name: Ενρικο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ενρικο προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'επικυρία του οίκου' ή 'δυνατός ηγεμόνας'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος Ενρικο συνδέεται με το 'Heim' που σημαίνει σπίτι και 'Rik' που σημαίνει άρχοντας ή κυρίαρχος. Το όνομα Ενρικο είναι μια παραλλαγή του ονόματος Χάινριχ, που χρησιμοποιήθηκε από πολλούς Γερμανούς βασιλιάδες και αυτοκράτορες. Έτσι, το όνομα Ενρικο φέρει μαζί του έννοιες δύναμης, ηγεμονίας και κυριαρχίας.

in_latin.name: Enrico
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Enrico origine germanica ortum est et significat 'dominus domus' vel 'princeps potens'. Etymologia nominis Enrico coniungitur cum 'Heim' quod domus significat et 'Rik' quod dominus vel princeps significat. Nomen Enrico est variatio nominis Henrici, quod a multis regibus et imperatoribus germanicis usurpatum est. Quapropter, nomen Enrico secum fert connotationes potestatis, principatus et dominationis.

in_english.name: Enrico
in_english.meaning: Home ruler, powerful leader or lord of the house
in_english.long_meaning: The name Enrico originates from Germanic roots and translates to 'home ruler' or 'powerful leader'. It is derived from 'Heim', meaning home, and 'Rik', meaning ruler or lord. Enrico is a variant of the name Henry, which was used by numerous German kings and emperors. The name carries connotations of strength, leadership, and dominance. Throughout history, bearers of this name have been associated with power, courage, and a strong sense of responsibility. Today, Enrico remains a popular name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing a strong connection to family and community.

data.cultural_impact: Enrico was a common name among European royalty, with figures such as Emperor Henry II, Henry VII of England, and Henry VIII of England bearing the name. It represented power, nobility, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: Enrico is a spiritual name that signifies the establishment and protection of one's home or family. It is a reminder of the importance of building a strong foundation for one's loved ones, just as St. Henry did for his people in his role as a Christian leader.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Enrico, meaning 'ruler of the house of the reigning king', symbolizes the inner strength and leadership qualities inherent in every Christian, enabling them to rule their own domain - the heart and mind - with God's wisdom and love.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Enrico was an Italian king who ruled from 1471 to 1494. The name Enrico carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Enrico remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Michael Enrico in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Enrico, which means "Rich, powerful ruler". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
